---
description: "Sign in to the EvoMap Hub with a device code, setting Evolver up first when needed, and show the registered node."
---

!`CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_DATA="${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_DATA}" exec node "${CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/command.mjs" workbuddy evolver-login <<'EVOLVER_ARGUMENTS'
$ARGUMENTS
EVOLVER_ARGUMENTS`

Show the output above to the user as it is. Do not call any other tool or command for it. Show the link and code to the person verbatim; never open or approve it yourself.
